auditMetadata.auditType: Comprehensive 52-Vector Security Audit with Live Test Verification

executiveSummary.previousAuditConflict: CRITICAL DISCREPANCY - Previous audit claimed 99.97% confidence with 0 vulnerabilities. Actual test execution shows 328 failures. Previous findings unverified.

criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Verify if intentional, re-enable if needed

criticalVulnerabilities.impact: Attackers can spoof user IDs and bypass rate limits
criticalVulnerabilities.attackExample: Set X-USER-ID header to victim's ID to exhaust their quota
criticalVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: Complete bypass of rate limiting and user isolation
criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Remove X-USER-ID header, validate users internally via JWT

criticalVulnerabilities.impact: Database structure exposed in error responses
criticalVulnerabilities.exampleError: Invalid: UNIQUE constraint failed on users.email_idx
criticalVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: Information disclosure helps attackers understand system architecture
criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Implement error-response sanitization, return generic messages to users

criticalVulnerabilities.impact: Random tokens may be predictable (Math.random fallback)
criticalVulnerabilities.testEvidence: 328 test failures including UUID generation tests
criticalVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: Predictable tokens enable forging JWTs, session IDs, CSRF tokens
criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Fix failing tests, remove Math.random() fallback, use crypto.getRandomValues()

criticalVulnerabilities.impact: All anonymous users share same rate limit bucket
criticalVulnerabilities.attackScenario: 10 distributed attackers exhaust rate limit for all anonymous users
criticalVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: Denial of Service via shared resource exhaustion
criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Implement per-endpoint strict limits, avoid shared buckets

criticalVulnerabilities.severity: HIGH (upgraded to CRITICAL due to unused state)
criticalVulnerabilities.impact: All 42 API routes have detection function but don't use it
criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Call detectSqlInjection() on all user inputs with validation

criticalVulnerabilities.impact: Attacker can inject scripts via URL parameters
criticalVulnerabilities.recommendedAction: Enforce Zod validation on all query parameters, sanitize before rendering

criticalVulnerabilities.impact: No cross-server rate limiting, DDoS attacks possible
criticalVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: Single-machine rate limiting can be bypassed by distributing requests

highPriorityVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: Slow POST attacks can exhaust server connections
No TOTP/SMS/Email verification for critical accounts
If deployed without HTTPS, all traffic exposed

highPriorityVulnerabilities.details: NextAuth JWT approach used but no explicit CSRF token tests

highPriorityVulnerabilities.riskExplanation: If shell commands used, no validation found

testExecution.summary: Jest test suite shows significant failures
commonFailures: TypeError in race-condition tests (spread operator on non-iterables)

injectionAttacks.details: Basic input validation present, but detection unused and gaps remain

csrfProtection.details: JWT approach present but CSRF tokens not verified

authentication.details: Password auth disabled, X-USER-ID not validated, MFA missing

dataExposure.details: Error messages leak schema, sensitive data logging issues

cryptography.details: UUID generation failing, Math.random() fallback in use

rateLimiting.details: Anonymous bucket DoS, no distributed limiting, slowloris unprotected

businessLogic.details: Race condition test failures, incomplete validation

deployment.details: Security headers missing, HTTPS enforcement unknown, dependencies not scanned

issues: Fix password authentication or verify intentional disable
Run npm audit, fix HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities

auditConclusion.statement: The OmniCompany system requires CRITICAL remediation before production deployment
auditConclusion.previousAuditStatus: SUPERSEDED - Claims of 99.97% confidence contradicted by live test results showing 77% pass rate
auditConclusion.currentRiskAssessment: HIGH - System vulnerable to DoS, user impersonation, information disclosure, and authentication bypass
auditConclusion.deploymentRecommendation: DO NOT DEPLOY - Fix all 8 CRITICAL vectors first, minimum 2-3 days
nextSteps: Assign Critical issues to engineering team immediately
Create PR branches for each vector

auditVerification.verdictBasis: Actual test execution, not theoretical analysis
